targets.expr: 100 * sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~"$container", image=~".+falkordb.+"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod) / clamp_min(sum(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="cpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~"$container"}) by (pod), 1e-9)

panels.description: Green line = actual ratio (allocated/used). Red line at 1.5 = alert threshold (FalkorDBMemoryFragmentationHigh fires if sustained >10m).

targets.expr: redis_falkordb_total_graph_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~"$container"} and on(pod, namespace) redis_instance_info{namespace="$namespace", role="master"}

panels.title: Top Graph Commands by Time-Spent Rate

panels.title: Graph Commands / sec

panels.description: Average latency per graph command per pod. graph.QUERY, graph.RO_QUERY, graph.PROFILE and graph.EXPLAIN only.

targets.expr:
sum(rate(redis_commands_duration_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~"$container", cmd=~"(?i)^graph\\.(query|ro_query|profile|explain)$"}[5m])) by (cmd, pod)
/ clamp_min(sum(rate(redis_commands_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~"$container", cmd=~"(?i)^graph\\.(query|ro_query|profile|explain)$"}[5m])) by (cmd, pod), 1e-9)

panels.title: Avg Query Latency (Graph Commands)

targets.expr:
sum(irate(redis_commands_duration_seconds_total{pod =~ "$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"$container"}[1m])) by (cmd, pod)
  /
sum(irate(redis_commands_total{pod =~ "$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"$container"}[1m])) by (cmd, pod)

Total Time Spent by Command / sec

sum(100 * sum(redis_memory_used_bytes{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"$container"})  / sum(redis_memory_max_bytes{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"$container"}))
sum(redis_falkordb_total_graph_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~"$container"} and on(pod, namespace) redis_instance_info{namespace="$namespace", role="master"})
